leads.title: Minnesota Human Rights Act - 1993 sexual orientation/gender identity amendment
leads.documents: First-in-U.S. statewide ban on discrimination based on sexual orientation and gender identity in employment, housing, public accommodations, insurance, contracts, health benefits, hospital visitation
leads.detail: Cited as 1993 amendment to statutes; includes quoted definition of 'sexual orientation'; notes 2024 reclassification and May 2023 omnibus community justice bill reforms; no URL visible in text

leads.title: Doe et al. v. Ventura et al. (2001)
leads.documents: State District Court ruling by Judge Delila F. Pierce that Minnesota sodomy law violated State Constitution for private, adult, consensual, non-commercial acts; voided law pre-Lawrence v. Texas
leads.detail: Cited as Doe et al. v. Ventura et al. (2001), certified as class action, state did not appeal; no URL visible in text

leads.title: Baker v. Nelson (1972)
leads.documents: Minnesota Supreme Court ruling that state law limited marriage to opposite-sex couples, appeal dismissed by U.S. Supreme Court; history of same-sex marriage legal status
leads.detail: Cited as 1972 lawsuit by Jack Baker against Hennepin County Clerk Gerald R. Nelson; no URL visible in text

leads.title: In re Guardianship of Kowalski (Dec 17, 1991)
leads.documents: Minnesota Court of Appeals landmark ruling awarding guardianship of brain-damaged Sharon Kowalski to lesbian partner Karen Thompson over parents' objections
leads.detail: Cited as overturning lower court ruling; no URL visible in text

leads.title: House File 146 - 'Trans Refuge Bill' and March 2023 Executive Order
leads.documents: Legal protection for gender-affirming services and care anywhere inside Minnesota; codified executive order as permanent state legislation effective immediately
leads.detail: Cited as passed April 2023, signed by Governor Tim Walz; executive order signed March 2023; no URL visible in text

leads.title: Minnesota conversion therapy ban - State law April 2023 and Executive Order July 2021
leads.documents: Statewide legal ban on conversion therapy practices, plus prior city ordinances in Minneapolis (Nov 2019), Duluth, St. Paul, Red Wing, Winona, Rochester, Robbinsdale, Bloomington, Richfield
leads.detail: Cited as bill passed April 2023 signed by Gov. Tim Walz effective Aug 1, 2023; executive order signed July 2021; no URL visible in text

leads.title: Omnibus Judiciary and Public Safety Bill (May 2023) - sodomy repeal
leads.documents: Formal repeal of defunct sodomy law (previously penalized up to 20 years, reduced 1967, addressed in State v. Blom 1984, State v. Gray 1987); signed by Gov. Tim Walz effective immediately
leads.detail: Cited as passed Minnesota Legislature May 2023; no URL visible in text

leads.title: Minnesota hate crime law - 1989 and 1993 expansion
leads.documents: Additional penalties for crimes based on victim sexual orientation (1989) expanded to include gender identity (1993) alongside race, religion, sex
leads.detail: Cited as 1989 expansion and 1993 gender identity inclusion; no URL visible in text

leads.title: Movement Advancement Project - Minnesota's Equality Profile
leads.documents: Institutional ranking noting Minnesota first tied with Illinois in Midwest for LGBT rights legislation: employment/housing/public accommodations/credit protections, inclusive trans healthcare, self-ID gender marker correction
leads.detail: Listed under External links as 'Minnesota's Equality Profile - via the Movement Advancement Project'; no direct URL visible in text

leads.title: Public Religion Research Institute (PRRI) 2022 poll
leads.documents: Public opinion data: 77% of Minnesota residents supported same-sex marriage, 82% supported discrimination protections covering sexual orientation and gender identity
leads.detail: Cited in text as 2022 PRRI poll with 21% opposed marriage, 16% opposed protections; no URL visible in text
